How Much Does It Cost to Make a Hoodie in Pakistan? (Real 2026 Factory Numbers)

✎ FABRIOZA Team 📅 August 1, 2026 🔄 Updated: August 1, 2026 ☕ 7 min read
Home › Blog › Hoodie Cost in Pakistan
TL;DR: From our Sialkot factory floor in 2026: a 280–350 GSM French terry hoodie costs $12.00/unit at 50 pieces, falling to $8.40 at 500+. Premium 400–450 GSM heavyweights run $14–$19. Add $2.50–5.00 for 3D puff embroidery, $1.50–3.00 per screen-print location, $0.30 for a woven label. Express DDP shipping adds roughly $1.50–2.50/unit at 100 pieces. Full math below.

Google suggests this exact question — and until now no Pakistani factory answered it with numbers. These are the prices we quote daily, published. Compare them to anyone.

Base Garment Cost by Spec

Hoodie specAt 50 pcsAt 100 pcsAt 500+ pcs
Standard 280–350 GSM French terry/fleece, custom label$12.00~$10.80$8.40
Heavyweight 400–450 GSM, garment-dyed/boxy$14–19$13–17$10–13
Zip-up version+$1.50–2.50(YKK-style zip + placket work)

What Moves the Price

  • Fabric weight is half the cost. Going from 300 to 450 GSM adds ~50% more cotton per garment, plus slower sewing. Pakistan's advantage: the fleece is knitted and dyed locally from home-grown cotton — no imported-fabric premium.
  • Decoration: screen print $1.50–3.00 per location; 3D puff embroidery $2.50–5.00; all-over sublimation $3.00–6.00 (see the full add-on table).
  • Branding pack: woven label $0.30, hang tag + poly bag $0.50, custom mailer $0.25.
  • Quantity: volume discounts run 10/20/30/40% at 100/250/500/1,000+ pieces.

Worked Example: 100 Hoodies, Delivered to the USA

Base: 100 × 320 GSM hoodie @ ~$10.80$1,080
Puff-embroidered chest logo @ $3.50$350
Woven labels + hang tags + bags @ $0.80$80
Express DDP air freight (approx.)$200–250
Landed total / per unit~$1,730 / ~$17.30

At a $60–75 retail price — normal for heavyweight streetwear — that is a 71–77% gross margin. The same spec from a US cut-and-sew studio typically lands at $35–55/unit; from China, similar to Pakistan on FOB but with US tariff exposure working against it.

Frequently Asked Questions

How much does it cost to manufacture a hoodie in Pakistan?

From a Sialkot factory in 2026: $12.00 per unit at 50 pieces for a standard 280-350 GSM custom hoodie with your label, falling to $8.40 at 500+. Premium 400-450 GSM heavyweights run $14-19 at small quantities. Decoration and shipping add $2-6 per unit depending on spec.

Why are Pakistani hoodies cheaper than Chinese ones for small orders?

Pakistan grows its own cotton and knits fleece locally, removing the imported-fabric premium, and its factories accept 50-piece orders without surcharges. For US brands, Chinese quotes also carry Section 301 tariff exposure on top of MFN duty.

What GSM should my hoodie be?

280-350 GSM is the standard premium range - substantial but wearable year-round. 400-450 GSM is the boxy heavyweight streetwear feel. Below 250 GSM reads as budget retail and hurts reorders.

How many hoodies do I need to order from a factory?

Most overseas factories want 300-1,000 pieces. FABRIOZA's standard MOQ is 50 pieces per style, and a 20-piece trial order lets you test production quality first with the cost credited toward bulk.

How long does hoodie production take in Pakistan?

Sample in 5-7 business days; production 3-4 weeks after sample approval for typical small orders; express DDP delivery 3-7 business days via DHL/FedEx/UPS.
